name: P2N2222AG
description: onsemi P2N2222AG, a NPN transistor in TO-92 (C1, B2, E3): VCEO 40 V, 0.6 A, 0.625 W at 25 C ambient; hFE at least 35 at 0.1 mA, 50 at 1 mA, 75 at 10 mA and 100 to 300 at 150 mA; VCE(sat) 0.3 V maximum and VBE(sat) 0.6 to 1.2 V at 150 mA. The model's gain is 173, the geometric middle of the 150 mA limits.
